findVerse.name: John 3:16 or keyword
findVerse.label: the reference box above the chapter list (Enter opens the chapter, selects the verse and previews it)

show.label: Escape leaves the reference box, so the next Enter acts on the selected verse
Enter presents the selected verse on the output

clear.name: Clear scripture from output
clear.label: the CLEAR button in the top bar (its name reads "Show scripture again" while the output is already clear)
